app.title: Structure Alignment Suite
app.summary: A person uploads or fetches two or more protein structures, picks one as the reference and one or more as mobiles, chooses the chains, alignment mode and strategy, and runs the alignment. The result opens with a plain-language quality verdict and fold-similarity metrics. Tabs show the chain mapping and flagged regions, a 3D superposition coloured by deviation, and a per-residue deviation plot. When several mobiles are chosen, an ensemble tab shows an RMSD matrix, clustering and PCA. An optional evaluation ranks the mobiles as models of the reference by interface or fold score. Everything can be downloaded as a reproducible bundle, with aligned coordinates, tables, plots, viewer scripts and a report.

task.text: Superpose protein structures onto a reference, measure how closely each one matches, and rank predicted models against an experimental structure.

data.text: 3D atomic coordinate files of protein structures, each with one or more chains, plus the per-residue deviations, chain mappings and scores computed from them.
data.item: a protein structure (PDB/mmCIF file or a fetched PDB/AlphaFold entry) aligned against a reference structure

stage.text: comparing predicted or solved structures against a reference, after models exist and before reporting

mechanism.text: A sidebar collects the structures and alignment settings and runs the alignment. The results show a persistent verdict header above tabs, each giving another view of the same superposition: the chain mapping, a 3D overlay, a per-residue plot with shaded flagged regions, an ensemble matrix and clustering, a ranked evaluation table, and an export bundle.

field.text: protein structure superposition and model assessment in structural biology

workflow.name: align items to a reference and score how closely each matches

steps.here: Upload PDB/mmCIF files or fetch entries by ID (pdb:XXXX, af:UniProt). The app waits until at least two structures are loaded.

steps.step: choose the reference, the items to compare and the settings
steps.here: Pick one reference and one or more mobiles, the reference chains, the alignment mode (auto, sequence-guided, sequence-free, flexible) and the multi-chain strategy. Under Advanced, set gap penalties, the atom set and pLDDT / B-factor floors.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Run superposes each mobile onto the reference and reports RMSD, TM-score, GDT_TS, lDDT-Cα and coverage. A banded verdict, a confidence level and warnings head the results.

Overview lists the method, chain mapping, per-chain RMSD and flagged regions. 3D overlays the mobile on the grey reference, coloured by RMSD, pLDDT or chain. Per-residue plots the deviation with flagged runs shaded, and expanders hold the sequence alignment and distance matrices.
With several mobiles, the Ensemble tab shows a summary table and a pairwise RMSD heatmap. A cluster-count slider drives K-means, a PCA plot and a dendrogram.

With model evaluation turned on and receptor/ligand chains picked, the mobiles are ranked by DockQ (or by TM-score). The best model and its CAPRI class are shown, and in antibody mode epitope F1 and CDR-H3 RMSD are added.
Download the aligned PDB from the 3D tab or the ranking CSV, or build a ZIP bundle with the aligned structure, RMSD CSV, plots, PyMOL/ChimeraX scripts and report.

distinctive: Residue correspondence can come from the sequence or from shape alone, and auto mode keeps whichever candidate has the better coverage-weighted score.
Multi-chain complexes get an automatic chain-to-chain mapping, with a choice between a global (all chains) and a local (best chain pair) superposition.
A plain-language verdict, with a confidence level that drops for low coverage, weak chain identity or disagreeing strategies, sits above every metric.
Confidence filters differ by structure type: a pLDDT floor for predicted models and a B-factor floor for experimental ones.
Interface scoring (DockQ, CAPRI class), plus epitope F1 and CDR-H3 RMSD in antibody mode, ranks predicted complexes.

parts.title: Quality verdict header
parts.summary: Shows a coloured band, a one-line verdict, the five headline metrics, a confidence level and any warnings for the current alignment.

parts.title: Overview
parts.summary: Lists the method and strategy used, the reference-to-mobile chain mapping with percent identity, per-chain RMSD and the flagged high-deviation regions.

parts.title: 3D superposition
parts.summary: Overlays the aligned mobile on the grey reference in an interactive 3D viewer, coloured by per-residue RMSD, pLDDT or chain, and offers the aligned PDB as a download.

parts.title: Per-residue deviation
parts.summary: Plots per-residue RMSD along the chain with flagged regions shaded, and has expanders for the sequence alignment, the distance matrix and the paired-distance histogram.

parts.title: Ensemble
parts.summary: For several mobiles, shows a summary table and a pairwise RMSD heatmap, and clusters the models with a chosen cluster count into a PCA plot and a dendrogram.

parts.title: Model evaluation
parts.summary: Takes receptor and ligand chains, plus an optional antibody mode, from the sidebar. Ranks the mobiles as models of the reference by DockQ or TM-score and shows the best model's scores, with a CSV download.
